YOU BOTH THINK THE OTHER HIT HARDER

GOAL
Two people can honestly think the other pushed harder.

ONE RULE
What happens when each person tries to return exactly the same gentle force they just felt?

PLAY
With a trusted person and only very light safe finger taps on a tabletop or palm, alternate matching the perceived force. Stop immediately if uncomfortable.

TWIST
See if force tends to creep upward.

WIN
Self-generated force feels attenuated, so matching another's force can overshoot.

MIND BEND
Both people can feel wronged by the same sensory prediction system.

SAFETY
Use this to lower heat and reduce mind-reading, not to excuse harm. Keep drafts unsent while activated; boundaries and direct communication beat guessed motives.
rituals.target_pattern: Reciprocal taps feeling unequal and escalating
rituals.theory_backbone: Sensory attenuation; force escalation; motor prediction
rituals.mechanism_fingerprint: Alternate very light safe force matching between two people to reveal systematic overshoot caused by attenuation of self-generated force.
